questlog.main.insurgence.intro.title: Welcome to Insurgence II!
questlog.main.insurgence.intro.desc_1: Your progression in this modpack is measured by your current Apotheosis World Tier.
questlog.main.insurgence.intro.desc_2: %s to read more about world tiers.
questlog.main.insurgence.intro.desc_3: This modpack features lots of changes to many established features.
questlog.main.insurgence.intro.desc_4: It is recommended that you read through the quests in this introduction chapter.
questlog.main.insurgence.skyblock_explan: You start your adventure in the Haven dimension, located high up above the Overworld
I suggest that you set up base here, since visiting other dimensions (even the Overworld!) has become very dangerous.
This pack has been designed around the Haven being your hub.
Other than the fact that you start in the sky, this is not really a skyblock pack.
questlog.main.insurgence.dimension_effec: The Blessings and Curses of Every Realm.
Every dimension in this pack gives a custom status effect.
Most of these effects are debuffs, but being in the Haven grants buffs instead
You can read about the specific effects in the corresponding dimension's chapter in this questbook.
The debuffs are harsh, but it is possible to reduce the harm they cause.
%s to read about how to do this.
questlog.main.insurgence.permanent_bonus: One major way of receiving permanent buffs is by collecting tarot cards in your Collector's Album.
The quality of the buffs, scale with the amount of cards you collect and their rarity.
Tarot Cards are found mainly through the large tower structures found everywhere in the Overworld.
%s to read about the tower structures.
questlog.main.insurgence.trial_towers.de: The Trial Towers are a series of structures which generate almost everywhere in the Overworld.
Every tower has a difficulty between 1-10. It is possible to tell how difficult the tower is by the color of its banners and how tall it is.
Upon completing any Trial Tower, you will be rewarded with a tarot card corresponding to the type of tower and its difficulty.
%s to read about the uses for tarot cards.
questlog.main.insurgence.death_changes.d: Whenever you die, you will not lose any items.
However, you will lose some of your experience when you die, so it isn't without consequence.
questlog.main.insurgence.equipment_chang: There are two distinct categories for all equipment: 'unique' and 'crafted'.
Unique equipment can only be found as loot rewards and cannot be crafted.
Crafted equipment is the inverse; it can only be crafted and cannot be found as loot anywhere.
Only unique equipment can have Apotheosis rarities and spell imbuements. However, what you find is random.
Additionally, whenever possible, all unique equipment will have a single curse applied to it.
Crafted equipment has the benefit of being unbreakable, making it more consistent at the cost of some strength.
questlog.main.insurgence.the_end.title: Travelling to The End
questlog.main.insurgence.the_end.desc_1: Going to The End in this modpack is different than normal.
questlog.main.insurgence.the_end.desc_2: All you need to do is travel above y 300 in the Haven, and you will be teleported to The End.
questlog.main.insurgence.the_end.desc_3: In addition to teleporting you below the main island, this method will cause you to take damage constantly without the proper protection.
questlog.main.insurgence.the_end.desc_4: Of course you probably want to be teleported onto the main island, and there is a block which can teleport you there.
questlog.main.insurgence.the_end.desc_5: Travelling to The End with this method also protects you from the constant damage you take in The End permanently.
questlog.main.insurgence.the_end.desc_6: %s to read about the Ender Eye ritual.
questlog.main.insurgence.mod_changes.apo: The progression between World Tiers has changed, and your tier will automatically upgrade when unlocked.
You cannot manually change your World Tier anymore.
The way you obtain equipment with Apotheosis Rarity has also changed:
Every loot chest is guaranteed to contain at least one affixed item, the quality of which is determined by your World Tier
The gems have new stat bonuses and obtainment methods.
The Apotheosis enchanting system has been removed in favor of the Enchanting Infuser.
The special Apotheosis bookshelves now only grant large amounts of bookshelf power.
questlog.main.insurgence.mod_changes.iro: Spellbooks are no longer obtainable. Instead all spells will be cast through other equipment imbued with spells.
There are two ways to imbue spells on items:
Some items are obtainable with spells already imbued in them.
And sometimes you can find an affixed item with an empty spell imbuement slot, which means you can imbue any spell into it.
questlog.world_tiers.insurgence.intro.de: To measure your progression, this pack uses Apotheosis' world tiers system.
However, the world tiers have been heavily customized.
Your current world tier has certain effects on both yourself and other mobs.
Additionally, each world tier will increase the quality of the loot you find in chests.
You can see the specific bonuses of your current world tier by opening the Apotheosis world tier menu.
To progress between world tiers, you will need to complete the quests in this chapter,
and once you have completed them all, your world tier will upgrade automatically.
questlog.world_tiers.insurgence.haven.de: The beginning of a brand new adventure; your sanctuary in the sky.
This is the world tier you start with. It provides no bonuses inherently.
It only gets better from here.
questlog.world_tiers.insurgence.apoth_ar: Obtain a Full Set of Affixed Armor
questlog.skies.insurgence.dimensional_ef: The dimensional effect of this dimension is a small buff.
The buffs provided by the Haven's Blessing can be improved later.
%s if you don't know about dimensional effects.
The base effects the Haven provides are:
questlog.skies.insurgence.punch_wood.tit: Punch Wood, Make a Crafting Table.
questlog.skies.insurgence.punch_wood.des: Hopefully you don't need any help with this part.
questlog.skies.insurgence.activate_wayst: You may have noticed the %s located on your island.
Interacting with that block will summon a few hostile enemies.
When they are all defeated, they will create a Waystone!
Waystones allow fast travel between any other previously discovered Waystone.
In this modpack, Waystones will always cost experience to travel.
This Waystone will allow you to travel back to your island easily.
Now that you have the waystone activated, you should jump off the island to land in the overworld.
You will be safe from serious fall damage when travelling between the Haven and the Overworld.
The Overworld is dangerous, so you will probably want to come back to your island.
One way to return is by finding another Waystone in the Overworld.
Another way to return is by dying. It is important to note that you keep your items when you die.
Finally, you can also return to the Haven by flying above y 400 in the Overworld.
